Oxide relationships

Cation proportions

Ratios use archived oxide estimates without renormalizing the measurements. FeOₜ is total iron expressed as FeO. Cation proportions are exploratory descriptors; mixtures and alteration can produce similar positions. They do not identify a unique mineral.

Orientation of published traces

Axial bearings are measured clockwise from north, from 0° to 180°. Segment length provides the weight. The result describes the displayed map traces; it is not a stress inversion or a measurement of subsurface fault orientation.

Use “Mapped feature type” to examine lineaments, ridge crests, channels or crater rims separately. Contacts are excluded.

Notes and imported layers are saved locally in this browser. Save workspace downloads a portable JSON file.

Data and coordinate provenance

Mars vector exports use GeoJSON geometry with explicit planetary metadata. Assign the supplied Mars CRS in desktop GIS; do not assume Earth WGS 84. ChemCam’s original latitude convention remains unspecified by its source.
